sources.finding: AccessSharePage performs GET on /s/featurestr, selects a JSON candidate containing loginstate, then reads separate uk and share_uk plus shareid from the same candidate. Comments describe older locals.mset and newer try{{...}} wrappers. The loose regex is implementation reference only; strict uniqueness/context proof is still required.

The transfer flow obtains tokens by a first GET AccessSharePage before extraction-code POST; the POST uk parameter explicitly uses tokens.share_uk. The second GET follows password verification. This is evidence of an implemented GET-first owner candidate path, not evidence that current production pages expose it.

getShareData reads a single locals.dump result; primaryid uses shareid.value and owner uk uses share_uk.value. This browser-state implementation distinguishes login uk from share owner semantics but cannot be executed as an isolated GET-only parser.

sourceAcquisition: Public GitHub source repositories cloned read-only for inspection; downloaded code was not executed. GitHub API rate limit returned 403 before fallback clone.
implementationRecommendations: Borrow candidate wrapper recognition and same-object share_uk/shareid semantics, not loose first-match regex acceptance.
Parse a unique bounded structured JSON object without eval, reject duplicate or conflicting fields, prove complete decimal owner/share IDs and exact current-session/record/child matches.
GET-only diagnostic must never call upstream repository transfer/password POST or browser scripts, and remains STOP-only until actual official proof is separately verified.
